item.title: Bulletin updated at 03:10 HKT 28/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will bring a few showers to southern China today. Meanwhile, a strong easterly airstream will reach the coast of Guangdong. With the easterly airstream being replaced by a humid southerly airstream, it will be warm during the day with coastal fog in the morning and at night over southern China tomorrow and on Monday. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong next Tuesday. Winds will strengthen and there will be showers over the region. Temperatures will fall gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Weather: Cloudy with a few showers. More showers in some areas at first. Coastal fog in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 20 - 22 C
R.H. range: 80 - 100 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
